verdict.rationale: Asking whether a document-processing product publishes its source under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a source repository, an open-source license, or readable source code. The only nearby item is a community remark that self-hosting the official Docker image was hassle-free, and a runnable image is not readable source under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
